evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No framing like 'this will take 10-15 minutes and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on.' Jack launches directly into logistics after customer provides house details.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Customer volunteers concerns about pods/loading liability and prep level; Jack does not ask 'what are your biggest concerns about this move' before probing logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by customer that required follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised; customer volunteered details voluntarily.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (4-bed house), sq ft (1985), location (Richardson to NC), storage scenario (pods, couple months), special considerations (staging, pre-wrapped/boxed items, minimal furniture, no heavy items), beds (king + queen, standard), desks (simple flat-top), all gathered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: No. Jack never offered 'would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' Customer pre-packed most items themselves.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No. No discussion of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: $202/hour for two movers, $505 minimum (2.5 hrs), $808 estimated for ~4 hours. Personalized to customer's prep level: 'based on what you've told me you seem like you're very on top of this move... how much time that saves versus the other way.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full — Trip/travel fees explicitly disclaimed ('we don't do any credit card processing fees, we don't do any travel fees, we don't do any material charges'), 2.5-hour minimum stated, 15-minute increment framing present ('anytime after the two and a half hour minimum is pro rated fifteen minutes at a time'). No 'not a guess' language.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Jack never says 'does that feel fair?' and pauses.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None. No mention of on-time guarantee or discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None. No mention of 'No Worries' $2,000 damage coverage, no-deductible framing, or that it's built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Jack does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' The call moves to blanket pricing discussion and then to booking logistics without returning to the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. No version of 'what's still concerning you about this move?' Customer initiates a final question about blanket pricing/sizing, but Jack does not ask a proactive final-concerns check.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: N/A — customer raised blanket-pricing question, but that is a product inquiry, not a move concern; Jack answered it directly.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. No 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Jack never says 'would you like our help with your move?' Instead he ends with 'we'll just wait to hear back from you guys' and 'just as soon as you know, want to lock it in, just let us know.' This leaves the booking decision entirely with the customer and provides an easy out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. 'there's no deposits upfront and there's no payments. Until the move is actually been completed' implies rate is locked, though not explicitly labeled 'rate-lock.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Jack confirms typical morning start time (8:30 AM) and customer confirms they'll stay at house the night before. Customer volunteer they're comparing with two other companies and will call back or email to book. No explicit confirmation of: phone number, arrival window (only start time), crew size (implicitly two movers, not explicitly confirmed), addresses (customer mentioned Richardson to NC, never explicitly confirmed back by Jack), or notes left for crew about customer concerns.

top_strength: Jack gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently and provided a thoroughly personalized, anchored estimate ($202/hr, 2.5-hr minimum, 15-min increments) that accounted for the customer's preparation level and pod-loading scenario.
coaching_note: Jack skipped Section 1's quid-pro-quo framing entirely, never asked their agenda before probing, never delivered the Two Promises, and ended with 'wait to hear back from you' instead of an explicit ask for the business—three critical closing-path breaks that left the customer with full permission to shop competitors and no reason to commit.
